param.name: popmean
param.label: Column with the population mean (popmean)
param.help: In per-row mode the value in this column of every row is used as popmean for that row; in per-column mode the first value of the column is used

param.label: How zero-differences are treated
param.option: Pratt treatment: includes zero-differences in the ranking process
Zero rank split: just like Pratt, but splitting the zero rank between positive and negative ones

param.label: Which function of the data to use in the test
Interpolation method
param.help: Used when the desired quantile lies between two data points i and j

param.label: Classification of values equal to the grand median
param.help: Determines how values equal to the grand median are classified in the contingency table

param.label: Method used to find the optimal Box-Cox transform parameter
param.option: All: use both optimizations and return all

param.label: Interpretation of the resulting score
param.option: rank: average percentage ranking of score
weak: percentage of values weaker than score
strict: percentage of values strictly weaker than score
mean: average of weak and strict

param.label: Method used to assign ranks to tied elements
Statistic to compute in each bin

Method used to combine the p-values

param.help: Only used if a single column is selected. Ignored if two columns (successes and failures) are selected

Lower limit

param.label: Alpha

param.help: Score that is compared to the elements of the sample

param.help: Axis along which to compute, use 0 for one-dimensional data

param.help: Value to put in place of values outside of bounds

param.label: Fisher's definition
param.help: If True, Fisher's definition is used (normal ==> 0.0). If False, Pearson's definition is used (normal ==> 3.0)

param.label: Biased

param.label: Include upper limit
param.help: Determines whether values exactly equal to the upper limit are included

param.label: Number of resamples
param.help: More resamples give more precise results but take longer to compute. Start small to verify results

param.option: independent: labels are exchanged between the two samples
samples: observations are exchanged within each sample (H0: identical distributions)
